g.title: cluster_pipeline
g.text: 3 · One pipeline · the model is a step inside it

g.title: synth
g.text: Stand-in dataset, built to the documented shape
same columns, same source mix, same join gaps

g.title: query
g.text: your SQL, run against your warehouse

g.title: contract
g.text: which column is the entity, the label,
the features — inferred, and reported back

g.title: shard
g.text: each node reads only the partitions
it holds — rows never cross the wire

g.title: featurize
g.text: point-in-time; the cutoff is never guessed

g.title: atrisk
g.text: survives the run that produced it

g.title: blocker
g.text: OPEN · after a run completes, the API stops serving reads
engine path verified in-process; the deployed surface is not

g.title: infer
g.text: Score an account not in the data
a missing feature FAILS, never zero-fills

g.title: report
g.text: how good the model is, what drives churn

g.title: q3
g.text: "Which accounts are most at risk, and why?"
